description: This file defines the Activity controller class for the Opencart admin dashboard extension. It manages the display and saving of activity widget settings and generates activity feed data for the dashboard.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Controller class for managing dashboard activity widget, including rendering configuration forms, saving settings, and generating activity reports.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the activity widget configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, configurations, and loading sub-views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the widget settings via POST request, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates the activity feed data for display on the dashboard, fetching recent activities and formatting them as HTML.
